title: Frozen Hearts - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Frozen Hearts in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: An ice-covered region holding Gargant and a set of cold-themed weapon rewards. It is one of the areas that flight opens up.

sections.title: How to Reach Frozen Hearts
sections.content: Reached from The Continent once Esquie's flight is available.
